summary: For jobs stuck in Pending, check `supervisorctl status`, make sure /var has more than 1 GB free and run `automation-controller-service restart`; if it persists, collect a sosreport and open a support case.
questions: Job stuck in pending automation controller
Why does my playbook stay pending?
How much space does /var need for controller jobs?

answer_card.title: Job stuck in Pending
answer_card.answer_md:
1. `supervisorctl status`: all services running?
2. `/var` must have **> 1 GB** free.
3. `automation-controller-service restart`
4. Still stuck: run `sosreport` as root and open a support case.
